// types: Tests may reach for Node APIs — reading a stylesheet off disk is the only way to assert a CSS Module's values, since jsdom never applies one. App code may not, which is why this lives here and not in tsconfig.json.
// exclude: Reset to empty so the tests tsconfig.json filters out are compiled here. `include` is inherited as ["src"] deliberately: narrowing it to test files alone drops src/app/router.tsx, whose `declare module '@tanstack/react-router'` augmentation types the router context — without it useRouteContext() silently degrades to `any` and unrelated files fail with implicit-any errors.
